name: GLUTEN FREE CAFE avan 渋谷本店 (GLUTEN FREE CAFE avan Shibuya Honten)
why: 渋谷本店 closed 2024-11 (relocated to Ueno as a churros takeout stand); the Ueno store closed 2026-05-10 and both FMGF and Tabelog now mark the business closed; the Maebashi branch closed 2024-07. The brand has no operating location, and the record's website domain avan-sweets.com no longer resolves.
